info.title: Tournevia Community — planning workspace
info.description: Company setup, named sessions, road-based calculation and manual review. Dispatch export requires a current validated READY plan; the demonstration mode (fictional data) cannot mark plans ready or export them.

Add ten fictional example deliveries for a day, with an example depot and two example vehicles
if they are missing. Examples are planned only with other examples (admin).
Delete every example depot, vehicle and delivery, with the plans of example vehicles (admin).

put.description:
Turn address lookup with IGN's public service on or off for the company. An installation
with its own geocoder always uses that one instead.

Set the company's safety margin for new calculations. Saved plans keep the margin they were
calculated with.

end.title: End

end.title: End

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: Days off and days with other hours, at most one per date; they replace the weekly hours on that date.

VehicleSource.title: VehicleSource
VehicleSource.description: A saved vehicle: weekly working hours and dated exceptions, not one dated window.

off_day.title: Off Day
off_day.description: Active vehicles that do not work on service_date: no weekly hours that weekday, or a day off.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Equipment codes held by at least one vehicle.

VehicleSummary.title: VehicleSummary
VehicleSummary.description: Fleet counts after the optional search; `off_day` is relative to the planning day.

WeeklyHours.title: WeeklyHours
WeeklyHours.description: Regular working hours for each day of the week; null for a day the vehicle does not work.
